City Council Regular Meeting
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
JANUARY 28, 2014
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL MEMBERS: Klinakis, Lewis, Argudo, Holloway, and House
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF A COMMENDATION TO LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF LEE BACA
PRESENTATION OF MILITARY BANNER CERTIFICATE TO SARAH MARTIARENA
Military Banner - Martiarena
INTRODUCTION OF ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES DIRECTOR ROBBEYN BIRD
PRESENTATION OF A COMMENDATION FOR EXCELLENT SERVICE
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL - None.
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENT NO. 138, AN ORDINANCE RESCINDING SECTION 10.60.020(33) PERTAINING TO UNCLASSIFIED USES AND SECTION 10.74.050(b) PERTAINING TO ELECTRONIC SIGNS; AMENDING SECTIONS 10.74.020 (DEFINITIONS) AND 10.74.150 (SIGNS ON PUBLIC PROPERTY WITHIN THE PUBLIC RIGHT OF WAY), AND ADDING SECTION 10.74.170 (ELECTRONIC DISPLAY BILLBOARDS) TO CHAPTER 10.74 (SIGNS AND ADVERTISING REGULATIONS) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE, TO ESTABLISH COMPREHENSIVE REGULATIONS FOR ELECTRONIC DISPLAY BILLBOARDS IN THE CITY AND CONSIDERATION OF THE INITIAL STUDY AND MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION REGARDING SAME
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council take the following actions: 1) Open the Public Hearing and take oral and written testimony; 2) Introduce and waive further reading of an Ordinance rescinding Section 10.60.020(33) Pertaining To Unclassified Uses and Section 10.74.050(B) pertaining to Electronic Signs and amending Sections 10.74.020 (Definitions) and 10.74.150 (Signs On Public Property Within the Public Right of Way), and adding Section 10.74.170 (Electronic Display Billboards) to Chapter 10.74 (Signs and Advertising Regulations) to the La Puente Municipal Code to establish comprehensive regulations for Electronic Display Billboards in the City; and 3) Approve the Initial Study/Mitigated Negative Declaration for the Project.
B-1 Staff Report - First Reading Billboard Ordinance - CC
B-1 Billboard PC Reso - Attachment A
B-1 Billboard Ord - Attachment B
B-1 Exhibit A - Initial Study - MND - Billboard Ord.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NOS. 1356
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolutions approving Warrant Register Nos. 1356.
WR # 1356
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE VOLUNTEER INCOME TAX ASSISTANCE ("VITA") PROGRAM
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council Resolution (Attachment "A") for Volunteer Income Tax Assistance Program/Earned Income Tax Credit.
D-2 Staff Report - VITA
D-2 Attachment A - VITA Resolution
D-2 Exhibit A - VITA letter and Events
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION IN SUPPORT OF HOUSE RESOLUTION 30 AND URGING THE UNITED STATES POSTAL SERVICE TO TAKE ALL APPROPRIATE MEASURES TO ENSURE THE CONTINUATION OF 6-DAY MAIL DELIVERY SERVICE
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt a Resolution (Attachment "A") in support of House Resolution 30 and urging the United States Postal Service to take all appropriate measures to ensure the continuation of 6-day mail delivery service.
D-3 Staff Report - USPS
D-3 Attachment A - USPS Resolution
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF THE RENEWAL OF THE ATTORNEY REPRESENTATION AGREEMENT WITH THE LAW OFFICES OF ATKINSON, ANDELSON, LOYA, RUUD & ROMO
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council renew the Attorney Representation Agreement with the law offices of Atkinson, Andelson, Loya, Ruud & Romo.
D-4 Staff Report - AALRR
D-4 Attachment A - AALRR Attorney Representation Agreement
D-4 Exhibit A - AALRR Attorney Letter and Rate Schedule
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING A SECOND AMENDMENT TO THE AGREEMENT WITH CIVIC SOLUTIONS, INC. FOR ADMINISTRATION OF THE DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $67,600, AND ADOPTING FINDINGS TO DISPENSE WITH THE CITY'S COMPETITIVE BIDDING PROCEDURES
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Amendment No. 2 to the Agreement between the City and Civic Solutions, Inc., and adopt findings to dispense with the City's competitive bidding requirements.
D-5 Staff Report Civic Solutions Second Amendment
D-5 Attach A - Civic Solutions Agreement
D-5 Attach B - Second Amendment Civic Solutions PSA
D-5 Attach C - Resolution Civic Solutions Second Amendment
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
QUARTERLY UPDATE ON CITY'S CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS - FISCAL YEAR 2013-14
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the presentation.
E-1 Staff Report - CIP Quarterly Update
E-2
SPECIAL EVENTS QUARTERLY UPDATE-FIRST QUARTER
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file.
E-2 Special Events Quarterly Report
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
Official Minutes Of 01-28-14 CC-SA
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this
___________________________________
Pat Jacquez-Nares, CMC, City Clerk
